description: For 100 shares per contract with one call written against them: net debit, breakeven at expiry, return if called and if not called (each with its per-year figures), highest and lowest P/L at expiry.

call_strike.description: Strike of the call written against the shares, in dollars.

contracts.description: Number of contracts; each covers 100 shares. Default 1.

days_to_expiry.description: Calendar days until the call expires.

premium.description: Premium received per share for the call.

share_price.description: Price per share paid for the stock (or its price now), in dollars, e.g. "50".

name: covered_call
title: Covered call returns
